cli.intro: Open Cleaner — scan disk usage, clean developer artifacts, inspect registry residue and PATH issues, and open the GUI.

cmd.scan: Scan a directory tree and print size entries
cmd.dev: Find and clean rebuildable developer artifacts (dry-run by default)
cmd.registry: Inspect Windows registry residue: orphan uninstall rows, dead file associations, failing startup items
cmd.env: Inspect and edit the Windows PATH value (report-only by default)
cmd.software: Find leftover install and config directories from uninstalled products
cmd.audit: Print the append-only capability audit history as JSON lines

opt.devRoot: Project root searched for manifests (repeatable, default: current directory)
opt.includeGlobal: Also include level-2 global caches, which can be rebuilt but must be re-downloaded
opt.only: Only select artifact directories with this name. Repeat the flag or use commas for several names, for example --only target,node_modules
opt.maxDepth: Maximum directory depth when looking for project manifests
opt.mode: Delete mode: trash keeps a recycle-bin copy, permanent cannot be undone
opt.concurrency: Cleanup workers. Default 1 (serial), clamped to 1..=8. More workers only help on high-latency volumes
opt.yes: Execute the selected changes instead of printing a preview
opt.index: PATH entry index from the dry-run report (repeatable)
opt.backupDir: Directory for the PATH backup JSON and .reg restore script
opt.legacy: Use the previous broken-install-location scan instead of residue analysis
opt.title: GUI window title
opt.actorId: Actor id recorded for every capability call (default: WAE_ACTOR_ID)
opt.actorKind: Actor kind: user or agent (default: WAE_ACTOR_KIND)
opt.actorSource: Actor entry point, for example cli, gui, plugin (default: cli)
opt.actorFilter: Only show records for this actor id
opt.since: Only show records at or after this Unix millisecond timestamp
opt.capability: Only show records for this capability name
